scope.network: Unthrottled HTTP loopback; no remote service or mobile network emulation.
scope.browserCache: Cleared and disabled before every navigation; fresh browser context, service workers blocked and bypassed.
scope.serverState: Running production Next build and Spring API; published fixture preparation warms server/database. This is not a cold server or cold machine benchmark.

limitsAndPolicy: All 12 baseline cold-browser navigations are retained, including the slower first sample. Later catalogue keyboard assertions failed on a test locator, independently of these completed measurements.
Encoded/decoded sizes come from ResourceTiming response bodies, summed by resource category at observed UI readiness; transport bytes and headers are recorded separately.
LCP and layout shift are snapshots at readiness, not final field Core Web Vitals. Three samples do not establish p95, field INP, a mobile-network budget or visitor-wide performance.
Budgets are fixed reviewable regression guards. Tests compare actual measurements with these values; they never raise limits from a new sample or retry a failure to hide it.

An exceeded latency limit on a different machine/network/profile must be investigated and the profile explicitly evaluated. Any deliberate budget change requires a documented review; no automatic exemption or increase.
No private data is cached to meet a budget. No price, teaching media or production traffic is inferred from these disposable fixtures.
